column1: # Batched drawing of model parts (dev.xavier.stein.bridge.engine.ModelBatch; on unless
# from scan/gl-calls.txt — do not edit by hand.
# Capture: vertices of each face while the ModelRenderer list is compiled (bct.d).
# Drawing: the parts' callList (render = a, renderWithRotation = b) goes to the batch.
# gfx/SteinEntityInstancer replaces ModelRenderer.render (bct.a(F)V) everywhere; it forwards to the original when inactive.
# Before ANY OpenGL call made by the game: flush (or restore, if it uses arrays/buffers).
